Variation seeks removal of basement level -2 , construction of additional storey to provide fourteen bedrooms in addition to amendments to the approved layout; the provision of 128 Class C1 accommodation rooms; the provision of 113 Class C1 accommodation rooms; an overall reduction of one bedroom when compared to the consented scheme (LPA Ref.
